summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on experience building object detection, tracking, and classification pipelines for robotics and autonomy systems. Built YOLO-based perception stacks on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object tracking and visual servoing, fused camera and time-of-flight sensor data for contact-aware grasping, and trained CNN classifiers (VGG-16/ResNet-50) evaluated on Dice Score and IoU. Experienced with ROS2, MoveIt, and RViz for robotic-arm kinematics, using PyTorch, CUDA, and TensorRT across the full perception-to-deployment pipeline.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/VGG-19/ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, restructuring task distribution to deliver the full segmentation pipeline within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush-detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects in real time, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and FreeRTOS-managed task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing for closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup, 17.6→92 FPS) for visual servoing, fusing dual VL53L0X ToF sensors with camera range-gating for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures across a three-layer distributed perception-to-actuation pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated CARLA data-generation pipelines (semantic segmentation + raycast occlusion filtering) producing ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) for lane detection; validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians, achieving zero collisions.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
